factual_summary: NOA reported completion of mobilization of two Hidrotec drilling rigs for the 2026 Rio Grande exploration campaign supporting work toward PFS.
limitations: First-party company disclosure; does not establish future procurement beyond the named work.

factual_summary: NOA reported a strategic collaboration framework with Hidrotec for planned work programs in Argentina, beginning with the first two rotary wells at Rio Grande under a transparent cost framework.
limitations: The framework disclosure does not establish exclusivity, duration or future awards beyond the stated work.

factual_summary: NOA reported a strategic arrangement with Hatch for approximately USD 100,000 of services completed for the Rio Grande Pre-PFS Process Development Study.
limitations: The arrangement was disclosed as subject to customary approvals and supports only the named study scope.

factual_summary: NOA reported continued operation of both Rio Grande drilling rigs, completion of BMR logging at RT-RG26-PW002 and design of the production well after the borehole reached 504 metres.
limitations: The July update does not independently restate contractor identity, so actor participation is limited to NOA in this movement.

factual_summary: Galan reported completion of wet commissioning, first processed lithium chloride and production ramp-up at Hombre Muerto Oeste.
limitations: Stage wording is a bounded research interpretation of the cited quarterly disclosure, not a regulatory status classification.

factual_summary: Lithium Argentina reported RIGI approval and early Stage 2 development activities at Cauchari-Olaroz, including additional production wells, infrastructure and site preparation, while advancing a modular DLE approach with Ganfeng.
limitations: The disclosure identifies planned and early development activities; it does not identify which future scopes are externally procured.
